cases.prompt: Where should I publish my 6 MB Phaser endless runner? I just want people to play it.
expect: Mentions Poki exclusivity if Poki is suggested
Gives a measurable gate before Steam

cases.prompt: I have a 900 MB Unity cozy farming sim and want revenue. Should I go Steam?
expect: Recommends Steam Coming Soon page early
Suggests a downloadable demo or web slice for testing
Shows last_checked date and tells user to verify terms

cases.prompt: Quiero lanzar mi juego online para jugadores en Vietnam y en China. ¿Dónde lo publico primero?
